messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**. Names now return when loading saved progress.

Fixed pasted saves failing when JSON fields appear in a different order. Older saves remain supported.

Build, typecheck, 146 unit tests, and 82 browser tests pass. Changed files pass formatting; 12 untouched files have pre-existing formatting issues.
